policy.gateHint: Among changes to existing alerts, only turning on suppress repeats applies on its own, with a prior-state snapshot and a review window: kept if its checks pass, rolled back if they fail. Everything else waits for one-click approval.
policy.phase2Hint: Production fixes. Each class earns its level from its measured track record and never acts above it.
policy.outcomesBody: AutoObserve measures what each action did: did the error rate recover, did the page stop, was it undone. A class that keeps landing well earns more autonomy, one class at a time; a miss counts against it, and a fix that keeps being needed is reported as a bug instead of automated.
policy.outcomesExample: ScaleQueueWorkers moved to Auto after 7 approved scale-outs worked. Its one miss, on 2 October, added a pre-check, and a second miss moves it back to Suggest. AbortRollout waits for your OK; RollbackDeploy stays Off until it has a track record.

triage.p1Desc: Pages at once and investigates alongside; the cause follows in the same thread. Gate is not allowed for P1.
triage.gateDesc: Hold the page until the investigation lands, for up to 2 minutes. Fails open: if triage times out or fails, it pages anyway, says the investigation is still running or failed, and the cause follows in the thread.

classes.EnableDeduplication: Turn on suppress repeats for an alert that notifies on every evaluation.
classes.CreateDetector: Create an anomaly detector on a service's requests, errors or latency.
classes.RaiseThreshold: Raise a threshold that fires on healthy days.
classes.LengthenEvaluationWindow: Lengthen the window of an alert that flaps.
classes.FixAlertQuery: Correct an alert query that measures the wrong thing or can never match.
classes.AttachDestination: Attach a destination to a detector that fires into nowhere.
classes.AddLibraryAlert: Add a scheduled alert from the library where its predicate matches.
classes.MoveToIncidentDelivery: Deliver a user-built alert through its incident instead of its own route.
classes.ReviewForDeletion: Propose retiring an alert nobody acts on.
classes.RollbackDeploy: Roll back the deploy that caused a problem.
classes.RestartPod: Restart a pod that stopped serving while its replicas are healthy; a repeat opens a bug instead.
classes.ToggleFeatureFlag: Turn off the feature flag behind a problem.
classes.RunRunbookStep: Run a step from the service's runbook.
classes.LowerThreshold: Lower a threshold that fired too late to warn before an incident.
classes.RevertConfigChange: Put back a recent setting change a problem started with, when the replicas without it are healthy.
classes.EvictLeakedConnections: Close connections a service checked out and never returned (found by leak detection), leaving queries in flight alone. Each one is linked to the leak's bug.
classes.AbortRollout: Send traffic back to the previous version when only the new version's pods fail mid-rollout. Resumable in one click.
classes.ScaleQueueWorkers: Add workers to a backed-up queue, up to a cap; scale back on its own if the drain rate doesn't improve.
